objects.name: Analytic 2179
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies transfer protocol traffic such as the Trivial File Transfer Protocol (TFTP) or vendor-specific protocol traffic initiating firmware-update mode on Industrial Control System (ICS) device Internet Protocol (IP) addresses from sources not in the approved engineering workstation list. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.
